artifacts.title: Action (pill)
artifacts.summary: Primary action = pill, filled Cavendish Yellow #FFE01B with a 1px ink ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #231E15 — live-measured), label in Peppercorn ink. On yellow/warm fields, primary switches to the dark variant. Secondary = outline pill (2px ink inset).

states: dark variant on warm fields (ink fill, white label)
hover: translateY(-4.875px) + hard ink shadow 0 4.875px 0 0 (live-measured, zero blur)
a11y: Real <button>/<a> semantics; visible label; focus must not rely on colour alone.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Typography (two registers)
artifacts.summary: Two registers: soft-serif display for hero/section headlines (with an italic emphasis fragment allowed inside a headline); grotesque sans for all body, UI, labels and metadata. Serif is the exception, never the working voice.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Screen type scale
artifacts.summary: Screen scale: display 48–64px w400 tight tracking (−1.2px at 64); section 35px/1.0; body 16/1.35; small 14; labels/buttons 13/500.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Colour roles
artifacts.summary: Roles: yellow = brand field + primary action only; peppercorn = text, ink, shadow tint; white + Parsnip = surfaces; Ochre = section band terminator; Kale = links inside content; #BF4055 = error text/fills.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Card (soft vessel)
artifacts.summary: Content cards: white, borderless, radius 16 (24 for large), elevation via warm ink-tinted shadow rgba(35,30,21,.2) 0 8px 32px; interior padding 48. Tinted variant: Parsnip, no shadow. 1px borders (#DEDDDC) only on inputs/dividers, never as card devices.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Shape classes
artifacts.summary: Shape encodes class: interactive = pill (always with the 1px ink ring); content vessel = 16/24 soft-radius; structural chrome (bands, dividers, page blocks) = square.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Section rhythm
artifacts.summary: One page title; sections = small uppercase label → display headline → 1–2 sentence paragraph. Numbers may take display treatment for proof moments.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Top bar
artifacts.summary: Top bar: white background; dark links; dropdown items carry chevrons; hover = light-grey rounded-rect fill; primary CTA at right end; must stay single-row (no wrapping).

a11y: Dropdown affordances need aria-haspopup/expanded when built; single-row layout.

source.repo: mailchimp.com live product + Mailchimp brand resources

artifacts.title: Field & small-set select
artifacts.summary: Native select styled as a field for small fixed sets (≤ ~12): more rounded (12px) with serif field text per Gate 2 review. Larger or filtered selection out of scope; use the platform-controls fallback and mark it.

a11y: <label for> always; native select for small sets.

artifacts.title: Ledger rows
artifacts.summary: Ledger: white surface, 16px padded rows, hairline #DEDDDC dividers (no zebra striping), header row in Parsnip with 13/500 labels; row hover = Parsnip tint; status pill inline; text links in ink with underline.

artifacts.title: Emphasis badge
artifacts.summary: Emphasis badges: pill, yellow fill, 12/600 label (e.g. 'Most popular' on the selected plan/category).

artifacts.title: Voice
artifacts.summary: Second person, question-first, plain English, non-blaming; dry wit allowed in microcopy; italic serif emphasis fragment allowed in headlines.
